title: Smoke and Aerosol Measurement Experiment
objectives: Measure the size of smoke particles produced by heating materials used in spacecraft, in microgravity, to understand the properties of this smoke and improve the design requirements of smoke and fire detectors.
approach: Samples of different materials were heated below their ignition temperature while temperature and air flow were controlled. The particles were then measured with aerosol analyzers, and samples were collected for examination with an electron microscope.
